texts.facts: This is petition filed under Section 166 of Motor Vehicles Act, seeking compensation of Rs.15,00,000/- from the respondents, on account of grievous injuries sustained by the petitioner in a road traffic accident. Due to said impact, the petitioner fell down and sustained grievous injuries all over the body. Hence, they are jointly and severally liable to pay compensation to the petitioner. It has contended that, the person driving the car bearing No.KA-05- ND-2101 was not having valid and effective driving licence to drive the said vehicle as on the date of accident. It seeks protection under Section 147 and 149 of Motor Vehicles Act. It has contended that, the petition is bad for non compliance of provision under Sections 134(c) and 158(6) of Motor Vehicles Act.
texts.arguments: It has further contended that, at the time of alleged accident, the petitioner was not wearing safety head gear and it is a clear violation of provisions under Motor Vehicles Act.
